stories.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a Pydantic response schema for provider detail including specialty, license status, practice address, phone, and enumeration date. Ensure consistent field naming, null-handling rules, and compatibility with tool_router validation.

stories.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse response payloads, and normalize provider attributes including taxonomy-to-specialty mapping, address formatting, and credential status extraction.

stories.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade and register as an allowed tool in tool_router with validated input/output contracts for agent consumption.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Tests (Unit + Integration)
stories.description: Implement unit tests for field normalization and parsing logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade through service to external API, including schema compliance.

stories.title: Handle NPI Lookup Errors and Incomplete Data
stories.description: Implement resilient error handling for API failures, timeouts, and partial NPI records, ensuring the system returns a valid schema with explicit nulls and no runtime failures.
